name: Postal Atelier
description: Oak desks, vintage letterpress and a citrus-tree lounge.
zhDescription: 橡木书桌、复古印刷机与柑橘树旁的休息区。

name: Garden Studio
description: A sunlit studio with a central garden, shared desks and a reading nook.
zhDescription: 环绕花园的共享工位，配有讨论区、阅读角和咖啡台。

name: Cloud Playhouse
description: Pastel craft desks, little kites and a cloud-filled reading wall.
zhDescription: 粉彩手作桌、小风筝与云朵书墙。

name: Sun Scriptorium
description: A celestial mosaic, sandstone desks and a sunlit fountain.
zhDescription: 星象拼花、砂岩书桌与阳光下的喷泉。

name: Neon Rooftop
description: A bright hardware studio above the city, with a hydroponic wall.
zhDescription: 城市上空的明亮硬件工作室，配有水培绿墙。

name: Orbital Observatory
description: Research consoles surround a star map beneath a planetary window.
zhDescription: 研究控制台环绕星图，窗外是蔚蓝星球。

name: Renewal Outpost
description: A reclaimed railway workshop with repaired tools and a vegetable garden.
zhDescription: 旧铁路工坊重新生长，修理工具与菜圃相伴。

name: Canal Archive
description: A cartographers' guild with canal windows and brass instruments.
zhDescription: 面向运河的制图工会，收藏黄铜仪器与航海图。

name: Bamboo Pavilion
description: Jade floors, inkstone desks and a bridge over a quiet water garden.
zhDescription: 青玉地面、笔墨书案与跨水小桥。

name: Woodland Guild
description: A woodland planning hall with a map rug and moss-green reading benches.
zhDescription: 森林议事厅，铺着地图地毯，设有苔绿阅读长椅。

name: Rose Library
description: Daylight through rose windows, pale stone and lilac writing chairs.
zhDescription: 日光穿过玫瑰花窗，映照浅色石材与丁香色座椅。

name: Moonstone Sanctum
description: Moonlit archives around a silver reflecting pool.
zhDescription: 银色映月池旁的静谧档案室。
